text_block_list.text:
The Kinko Sho.
Today's rival, Matikane Fukukitaru,
has yet to show up at the venue...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're late, Fukukitaru-san.
Where on earth did you go...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting! Dressed in my finest entrance attire,
I make my grand debut!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm completely different than usual.
And that's because—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: At a solemn shrine, I shall perform the Hundredfold Visit—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Deep in the mountains, under the waterfall,
for five, six whole minutes—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, I bought a whole bunch of good-luck charms at the 100-yen shop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It is I, Full Armor Fukukitaru—the incarnation of luck,
harboring all good fortune within myself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How is it, Bourbon-san!?
Is this the right way to do it Bourbon-style!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little scary~.
But... even so...!

A wall of fortune stands before reaching T.M. Opera O.
Meisho Doto must overcome it, no matter what.
